doc: Advisory registry of F4 semantic animation channels (Docs/AIRCRAFT_ANIMATION_PLAN.md §3.2). Units follow what FreeFalcon fed DrawableBSP::SetDOF/SetSwitch: rotational DOFs in radians, translator DOFs in feet, scale DOFs 0..1, switch channels as bitmasks (bit k = switch child k drawn). The canonical ids live in f4-anim/include/f4/anim/channels.hpp; this file is the human-facing + tooling-facing copy. Instance suffixes: .0..7 gear stations, .l/.r mirrored parts, .2 second engine.

channels.gear_pos: landing gear handle position, 0 up .. 1 down (drives the door/leg sequencer)
channels.sw.gear_leg.0: gear leg visible switch mask, station 0..7
channels.sw.gear_door.0: gear door visible switch mask, station 0..7
channels.sw.gear_hole.0: gear bay hole visible switch mask, station 0..7
channels.sw.gear_broken.0: broken-gear variant visible switch mask, station 0..7
channels.sw.nozzle: exhaust nozzle stage switch mask (1 << stage)
channels.sw.nozzle.2: second engine exhaust nozzle stage mask
channels.canopy: canopy opening 0..1 or angle per model
channels.sw.weapon_bay.0: weapon bay door visible switch mask, bay 0..4
channels.light.nav: navigation lights switch mask (blink pattern evaluated by the rig)
channels.light.strobe: anti-collision tail strobe switch mask (rig pattern: 0.08s on / 2.0s off)
